generator.chunks3.cubic.info: A vanilla overworld whose ground goes on down to bedrock at Y -4096
chunks3.configuration.title: Chunks3 Settings
chunks3.configuration.farDetail.tooltip: How far the far terrain reaches, in steps of about 8 km: 4 = 37 km, 11 = 94 km (default), 24 = 201 km (125 mi). 25 to 48 (up to 397 km, 247 mi) is the extreme range, for very powerful computers. Farther uses more memory and takes longer to fill in. Changes when you let go of the slider, also while playing. Also on the pause menu in cubic worlds.
chunks3.configuration.farTargetFps.toolt: A frame rate to hold, or 0 for off (the default). When set, far terrain sharpness steps down a choice at a time, no lower than Fast, while the game runs slower than this, and comes back up to the sharpness you chose when there is room again. It never goes sharper than your choice and leaves the far distance alone.
chunks3.configuration.farSharpness.toolt: How sharp far terrain looks: how close coarser levels take over. Sharper keeps finer detail further out but takes longer to fill in and uses more memory. Fast (the default) fills in quickest. Extreme and Ultra are for very powerful computers: they cost several times as much as Balanced and can drop to single-digit frame rates even on fast ones, Ultra most of all. Changes at once, also while playing. Also on the pause menu in cubic worlds.
How many far levels are drawn with block textures; further ones use flat colors. Default 8, all of them.
chunks3.configuration.farSmooth.tooltip: Draws far ground smooth instead of blocky, trees included. The four finest levels, which show your edits, keep their blocks, and so does a column with near cubes drawn within its height. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.farBlockTextures.t: Far textures keep one block's size at every level instead of half a voxel's, fade to their average color as they shrink to a few pixels, and coarse voxels are lit by their slope. Not tried under a shader pack. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.farFade.tooltip: Far levels fade into each other. Off, they meet at a visible seam. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.farZoom.tooltip: A zoomed view (spyglass, zoom mod, narrow field of view) asks for sharper far terrain where it looks, down to single blocks. Off keeps the far levels round the player alone. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.cubesCaveCull.tool: Leaves out near cubes that lie behind rock from the camera, as vanilla does for its sections. Off draws every cube in view. The shadow map still draws them. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.cubesShadowCull.to: Under a shader pack, near cubes go into the shadow map through Iris's own shadow frustum, leaving out what can cast no shadow into the view where the pack allows. Off culls by the map's box only. Shader packs only. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.cubesShadowCaves.t: With cave culling and shadow culling, where the camera is shut in, the shadow map takes only the cubes whose shadow can reach what the cave search found. Shader packs only. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.cubesOcclusion.too: Leaves out near cubes hidden behind others, tested on the GPU with OpenGL 3.3 occlusion queries (a Mac too). Off by default: on a GeForce RTX 2080 Ti under Photon the tests cost more than they saved. Restart the game to apply.
Meshing a near cube skips a cube of solid stone or deepslate sealed in by more of it on all six faces, below its column's sky: it is neither lit nor walked over. The same light and vertices. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.cubesReuseSnapshot: A near cube's blocks are copied once for all the mesh snapshots it is in (up to 27), kept for the last 1,024 cubes, instead of once for each. The same blocks. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.farLodDepth: Far terrain's own depth under shader packs
chunks3.configuration.farLodDepth.toolti: Under a shader pack, far terrain keeps a depth buffer of its own. Off makes it share the game's depth buffer. Shader packs only. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.farDhPacks: Shader packs made for Distant Horizons
chunks3.configuration.farDhPacks.tooltip: Under a shader pack that has a Distant Horizons terrain program (dh_terrain) and no Voxy code, far terrain draws with that program. Off leaves such packs with far terrain in plain colors. Not used when Distant Horizons is installed. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.farHiddenCull: Hide far faces behind far terrain
chunks3.configuration.farHiddenCull.tool: With the depth pre-pass, leaves out far faces that lie wholly behind other far terrain, tested on the GPU. OpenGL 4.3 only, so never on a Mac. The same pixels. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.farTwoPhase.toolti: With hiding of far faces (OpenGL 4.3 only), the depth pre-pass draws first the ranges the last frame's test showed, then only those they don't hide. Off by default: under Photon at Yosemite it left far cliffs hatched with holes. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.configuration.farQueryCull.toolt: Where far terrain draws in one pass (a Mac, no shader pack, or a pack without Voxy support), leaves out far ranges hidden behind terrain already drawn, using OpenGL 3.3 occlusion queries. Off by default: it was slower on the one card measured, and is not yet measured on a Mac. Restart the game to apply.
chunks3.sodium.allSettings.tooltip: Opens Chunks3's own settings screen, with the same settings as this page.
